summary: Eldorado Gold filed a Form 6-K announcing renewal of its normal course issuer bid (NCIB) approved by the TSX. The company may repurchase up to 13,065,993 common shares (5% of outstanding as of July 27, 2026) at prevailing market prices on TSX, NYSE, and alternative systems. The NCIB runs August 5, 2026 to July 31, 2027. Previous bid bought 7,739,880 shares at C$43.56 average. Most repurchases will be cancelled; up to 200,000 shares held in trust for RSU plan. Management cites undervaluation and strong cash flow; no fixed commitment. What to watch: pace of repurchases and share-price support.
